description: Source code for the TextureSelector class and related classes for handling GPU textures and format support in Windows using Direct3D 11 within the Chromium media project.

classes.name: TextureSelector
classes.description: Handles texture selection and format support for video decoding in Windows using Direct3D 11.

classes.name: CopyTextureSelector
classes.description: Derived from TextureSelector, manages copying textures when format conversion or copying is needed.

methods.name: SupportsZeroCopy
methods.description: Checks if zero-copy video is supported based on GPU preferences and workarounds.

methods.name: DxgiFormatToString
methods.description: Converts DXGI_FORMAT enum to a human-readable string.

methods.name: TextureSelector::Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a TextureSelector or CopyTextureSelector based on format support and configuration.

methods.name: TextureSelector::CreateTextureWrapper
methods.description: Creates a texture wrapper for the output texture.

methods.name: TextureSelector::DoesDecoderOutputUseSharedHandle
methods.description: Indicates if the decoder output uses shared handle.

methods.name: TextureSelector::WillCopyForTesting
methods.description: Indicates if the texture will be copied, used for testing.

methods.name: CopyTextureSelector::CreateTextureWrapper
methods.description: Creates a Direct3D 11 texture for copying purposes.

methods.name: CopyTextureSelector::DoesDecoderOutputUseSharedHandle
methods.description: Returns false, as copying textures does not use shared handle.

methods.name: CopyTextureSelector::WillCopyForTesting
methods.description: Returns true, indicating textures are copied for testing.
